onboarding.title: 🎵 Thanks for adding Lucky!
onboarding.description:
`/play <song or url>` — start music in your voice channel

After the first song plays (from `/play` or the button below), Lucky posts a Sunday recap of the server's most-played tracks and artists in that text channel, if it can post there. A server admin can turn it off with the button on the recap or `/recap off`.
